name: Mutual NDA from a Salesforce Opportunity
description: Started from the Opportunity (Start with Docusign): the NDA is filled from the Opportunity's Account, the customer's signer signs, then the rep; when it completes, the Opportunity's NDA Status field is set to Signed. The signed NDA is filed on the Opportunity as one PDF with the Certificate of Completion.
prerequisites: The Opportunity has a custom text or picklist field NDA_Status__c that accepts "Signed".
The Opportunity has its signer as its contact role: the workflow reads the first contact role Salesforce returns (one contact role per Opportunity keeps it exact).
